verdict.rationale: The skill ships as a plain open-source folder in the Agent Skills format, built around a SKILL.md and dependency-free Python tools. It can be installed by manually copying the folder or packaging it locally with tools/package_skill.py, so every instruction and script file is readable before and after installation. However, the docs never present a file manifest or an explicit review step; inspectability follows from the format and distribution rather than from a documented review feature. Missing for 10: a documented listing of all files and scripts the skill adds, explicit guidance for reviewing contents before install, and hands-on or independent confirmation of a pre-install review workflow.
